core_obligations: Derive the first assertion from descent along the faithfully flat completion map (proof lines 10710-10711).
Quote the counterexample for the second assertion (proof lines 10712-10714).
Use the description of Nagata rings to obtain the equivalence (proof lines 10715-10718).
difficulty_reason: The lemma records three facts about reducedness and completion for a Noetherian local ring: reducedness of the completion descends to the ring, the converse fails in general, and for a Nagata ring the two are equivalent. The proof derives the first from faithful flatness of the completion map together with descent of reducedness, cites an explicit counterexample for the second, and obtains the third from the standard characterisation of Nagata rings as those whose local domains are analytically unramified together with the resulting criterion for reducedness.
